fields.System.Title: INB-102 — View open ASNs for a warehouse
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to see what deliveries are expected, so that I can find
the right ASN when a truck arrives.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given open ASNs, when I query, then I get them with supplier, reference, expected
  • date, and line count.
  • - Given the list, then I can filter by supplier, by expected date, and by reference.
  • - Given a partly received ASN, then it still appears with its outstanding quantities.
  • - Given a fully received or cancelled ASN, then it does not appear in the open list.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | asn, asn_line |
